tess (Docs): Quick thread: updating Optimize docs for v2. Key items: note that prefix KV prefetch is opt-in, quant profile field rename (dtype -> tensor_type), add a tiny SDK migrate snippet, and fix a stale mkdocs redirect. Draft PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4402

omar (Eng): Thanks. Suggest a short migration checklist bullet list in the PR description so release notes can copy it.

sylvie (ML): Bench numbers for a small interactive case (seq=1024, batch=1): v1(prefetch on)=240 tok/s, v2(prefetch off)=190 tok/s, v2(prefetch on)=230 tok/s. I'll paste raw numbers if needed.

ben (SDK): I'll add an inline SDK example and a tiny unit test to assert `tensor_type` exists after migration. Snippet idea: ```py
from redwood import Optimize
opt = Optimize()
profile = opt.migrate_quant_profile('/tmp/p_v1.json')
profile['cache']['prefetch'] = True
opt.apply_profile(profile)
```

tess (Docs): Good, keep it short. Also include a one-line FAQ about `runtime.batch.max_delay_ms` causing unnoticed latency spikes when set too high.

ben (SDK): Pushed SDK draft PR with test. Will return a `migration_warnings` list that docs can display. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/sdk/pull/1004

ci-bot: Preview deployed for PR 4402 -> https://deploy-preview-4402--redwood-docs.netlify.app/optimize/migration-v2 (expires in 7 days) :white_check_mark:

tess (Docs): Preview looks good. Fixed the mkdocs redirect and updated wording to "schema update with automated conversion" instead of "breaking change". Merging after CI green.
